The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. Each collapsed cluster gets one crystal weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A 204 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital.
